lines.t: Keep your eyes open when voices grow loud
Claiming the throne with a borrowed crown
Storms will gather and distant thunders will sound
But let your spirit stay steady and grounded
Empires will crash and the ground will shift
Hunger and fever will walk through the streets
These are only the first quiet warnings
Not the final chapter, just the opening scene
Everything written will unfold
Yet the last page has not been turned
Hold the flame and refuse to forget
When the sky grows heavy, the road turns dark
The one who keeps walking will reach the far shore
Even when kindness freezes in the cold
The message of hope must cross every border
Only then will the story be complete
Keep walking, until the light breaks
They will drag the faithful into the fire
Some will be marked for the price they pay
The world will turn its face against the name
Many will stumble and trade away their trust
Shadows will rise wearing borrowed light
Teaching lies wrapped in gentle disguise
As darkness thickens, hearts will grow distant
But the ones who remain will not lose their way
Everything written will happen
Yet the last page has not been turned
Hold the fire and refuse to forget
When the sky grows heavy, the road turns dark
The one who keeps walking will reach the far shore
Even when kindness freezes in the cold
The message of hope must cross every border
Only then will the story be complete
Keep walking, until the light breaks
When the sacred place is defiled by the stranger
Those who understand will know the sign
Run to the high ground without looking back
Leave everything behind in that hour
The hardest days are drawing near
The one who keeps walking will reach the far shore
Even when kindness freezes in the cold
The message of hope must cross every border
Only then will the story be complete
Keep walking, keep walking…
Keep walking till the end
Keep your eyes open…
The ones who remain will stand
